statusLine.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$input = $input | Out-String | ConvertFrom-Json; $model = $input.model.display_name; $dir = Split-Path -Leaf $input.workspace.current_dir; $remaining = $input.context_window.remaining_percentage; $total_input = $input.context_window.total_input_tokens; $total_output = $input.context_window.total_output_tokens; $cost_input = [math]::Round($total_input / 1000000 * 3, 4); $cost_output = [math]::Round($total_output / 1000000 * 15, 4); $total_cost = [math]::Round($cost_input + $cost_output, 4); if ($null -ne $remaining) { Write-Host "$model | $dir | Context: $([math]::Round($remaining, 1))% remaining | Cost: `$$total_cost" } else { Write-Host "$model | $dir | Cost: `$$total_cost" }"
